 JUSTICE SASHIKANTA MISHRA  ORDER Order No. 15.5.2024.
04. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Addl. Standing Counsel for the State.
3.
The Petitioner is in custody since 15.5.2023 in connection with Chhatrapur P.S. Case No.356/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.76/2023 pending in the Court of learned Addl.
District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur, for the alleged commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/306 of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act
It is alleged that the Petitioner, being the uncle's son of the victim developed a romantic relationship with her and also had physical relationship with her.
As a result, the girl became pregnant.
Subsequently, she committed suicide.
5. Mr. J. Sahoo contends that the F.I.R. allegations are false inasmuch as the F.I.R. was lodged 9

7. Considering the submissions and the materials on record, I am not inclined to allow the prayer for bail which is therefore, rejected.
